summary.en: Korean free antivirus. Linaro's Works on WoA data lists it as native Arm64, validated by Qualcomm.
summary.zh-TW: 韓國免費防毒軟體。Linaro 的 Works on WoA 資料列為原生 Arm64，並經 Qualcomm 驗證。

caveats.en: Source covers Windows on Arm in general; RTX Spark was not tested.
caveats.zh-TW: 來源涵蓋一般 Windows on Arm，未針對 RTX Spark 測試。

caveats.en: Vendor page could not be read from this environment; the result rests on the Linaro catalog alone.
caveats.zh-TW: 此環境無法讀取原廠頁面，結果僅依據 Linaro 目錄。

caveats.en: Security software installs drivers; check the vendor's current support notes before relying on it.
caveats.zh-TW: 資安軟體會安裝驅動程式，使用前請先確認原廠最新的支援說明。
